# IGNITE-AI

> Predictive Fire Safety Analytics for Space Station Orbit & Rocket Transit

Open-source (Apache-2.0) flame-spread regime predictor for spacecraft materials, trained only on published NASA experiments.
- Dataset: 144 experiments from 13 NASA reports; CSV at /static-api/experiments.csv
- CV accuracy 0.729 (balanced 0.646), leave-reports-out 0.688, baseline 0.611
- Gravity levels with data: 0 g, 0.165 g (Moon), 0.38 g (Mars), 1 g; the range guard refuses untested material/gravity combinations
- Moon/Mars buoyancy scaling (sqrt g) values are labelled estimates

## Pages
- / : Home — Open-source tool that predicts flame spread over spacecraft materials from published NASA microgravity and partial-gravity experiments.
- /simulator : 3D Flame Simulator — Interactive 3D flame for Earth, Moon, Mars, ISS and transit-cabin conditions with sourced environment data and oxygen, pressure and airflow sliders.
- /predict : Prediction & Experiments — Flame-spread prediction with a range guard, decision boundary over real NASA tests, nearest experiments and FLEX CO2 data.
- /ask : Ask IGNITE-AI — Local question answering over a NASA combustion knowledge base; answers are verbatim quotes with source links.
- /safety : Safety Measures — Spacecraft fire detection, ventilation shutdown, suppression, material selection and crew procedures from NASA sources.
- /data : Data & Model — The 144-row NASA flame-spread dataset with quotes and the honest model card: cross-validation, per-gravity accuracy, confusion matrix.
- /sources : Sources & Citations — NASA PSI investigations, NTRS reports, environment and safety sources, FLEX data, and the AI-use disclosure.

## Data (static JSON, always available)
- /static-api/model.json
- /static-api/environments.json
- /static-api/experiments.json
- /static-api/safety.json
- /static-api/flex.json
- /static-api/psi.json

## API (only where the FastAPI backend runs; the static site computes predictions and answers in the browser instead)
- GET /health
- GET /api/environments
- GET /api/safety?env=iss
- POST /api/predict
- POST /api/ask {question}
- GET /api/flex
- GET /api/psi
- GET /api/model
